def fibonacci(n) -> int:
    
    # Base case
	if n == 0:
        return 0
   	if n == 1:
        return 1

    # Active flow
	curr_number = fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)

    # Passive flow
	return curr_number
